method: M&M replay production-option distillation with imminent-loss maintenance and separate terminal feasibility
rank_sample_weight: inverse sqrt positive action frequency capped 8; first 3 days times 4
negative_sampling: always WAIT plus hard spatial/action negatives
execution_guard: block duplicate held-item pickup and immediate shed transfer reversal; allow productive animal placement and end-of-day return
market_label: raw requested intent; teacher-forced own-request shadow; no future opponent fills
macro_scope: merge verified adjacent pickup/build/install and pickup/feed/fertilize chains; explicit per-worker positioned installation goals; raw market residual policy
resource_policy: buy only material deficits of committed jobs; reserve pledged feed/fertilizer from sales; repair affordable missing procurement before stopping
maintenance_policy: Reserve workers for currently observable feed/water obligations with consecutive missed days >=1, using travel and supply-fetch costs; block new production while such obligations remain.
terminal_rule: No forced daily maintenance or new capital on day 29; harvest/collect only if warehouse return and deposit fit remaining turns; return carried products at last feasible departure.
